# Gabriel's Menswear

> Menswear shop and tailor at 1363 Main St, Holden, Massachusetts 01520. Gabriel Sr., owner and Senior Master Tailor, helps customers choose a suit in the shop, checks the fit in person, and does the alterations. Suits for weddings and wedding parties, prom, funerals, interviews, business casual and formal wear, plus shirts, ties and accessories. Formerly Main Street Menswear.

- Phone: (508) 829-5186
- Address: 1363 Main St, Holden, MA 01520, United States (Central Massachusetts, near Worcester)
- Hours: Monday to Friday 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Sunday 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM, the same as the Google Business Profile. The site asks visitors to call to confirm before visiting.
- Walk-ins are welcome. A fitting can also be booked online at https://gabrielsmenswear.com/book for any day and time within shop hours; the customer sees a confirmation page and gets a confirmation email with a calendar file, plus a reminder email the day before for visits up to 30 days away. To change or cancel, call the shop.
- Prices are not published. They depend on the garment, fabric and work needed, and Gabriel explains the options and price before the customer decides.
- Customers can bring a suit they already own; Gabriel checks the fit and says whether altering it is worth it.
- Gabriel learned tailoring from his mother in Turkey and has more than thirty years of experience.
- Google rating shown on the site: 4.7 stars from the shop's Google reviews.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gabrielsmenswear.com/): the shop, reviews, Gabriel, common questions, hours and directions
- [Tailoring](https://gabrielsmenswear.com/tailoring): choosing a suit, the in-person fit check and alterations, including suits customers already own
- [Weddings](https://gabrielsmenswear.com/weddings): suits for the groom and coordinated fittings for the wedding party
- [Prom](https://gabrielsmenswear.com/prom): prom suits fitted in the shop; no need to know your size
- [Book a fitting](https://gabrielsmenswear.com/book): book an individual or group fitting, or call

## Common questions

- I don't know exactly what I need. Can I still come in? Yes. Walk in and tell Gabriel the occasion; he guides the suit, fit and finishing details.
- Can Gabriel help with a suit I already own? Yes. He checks it and says whether alterations are worth it before you spend money.
- Can you help with weddings, prom, funerals and interviews? Yes, with the look, fit and alterations for your timeline.
- Need it by a specific date? Call with the date; Gabriel will say whether there is time for the suit and alterations.
